messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: service/redwood-gen latency spike detected (p95 > 2s) — 3xx/5xx spike — paging on-call. Incident id: INC-2026-0423-01
Alex Chen: got the page, looking now. grabbing logs and recent deploys.
Alex Chen: timeline so far: spike started ~1769802950, coincides with config push to routing (deploy 2026-04-23_13:02).
Maria Gomez: tagging in — are customers seeing errors or just slow responses? any 5xx counts?
Alex Chen: ~20% increase in 5xx across EU region, some timeouts hitting frontends. Customer-facing errors reported in Sentry for two customers (acme-corp, finmate).
Sanjay Patel: oncall handoff in 20m — Alex if you need me to take over let me know.
Alex Chen: thanks. briefly tried scaling the pool, but saw queue growth. suspect a routing config change sent traffic to an incompatible model variant that spikes memory and causes eviction.
Kate Liu: pushing a rollback to previous routing config (2026-04-23_12:50) now. I'll monitor autoscaler.
IncidentBot: Deploy bot: rollback started by Kate Liu — revert routing config to 2026-04-23_12:50.
Alex Chen: after rollback, p95 improving but still elevated. some KV cache warmup issues likely.
Sanjay Patel: taking over primary. Alex, can you capture logs and relevant request ids, and put them into the incident doc?
Alex Chen: filing link: https://internal.incidents/redwood/INC-2026-0423-01 with request ids + sample stack traces.
Maria Gomez: notifying support about impacted customers and drafting status update.
Emily Rogers: product here — do we have customer impact estimate (number of requests, duration)? need to notify account teams if >1hr or >500 errors.
Sanjay Patel: rough numbers: ~45k requests affected over ~25 minutes, ~1.2k 5xx errors total. Major hit in eu-west-1.
Emily Rogers: ok starting outreach to Acme and FinMate now.
Kate Liu: autoscaler stabilized after rollback; new nodes coming up and p95 back to baseline ~10m after rollback.
IncidentBot: Incident update: mitigation in place — routing rollback applied, autoscaler healthy, degrade mitigated.
Sanjay Patel: marking incident as mitigated. Next steps: schedule post-incident review (postmortem) and RCA draft. Who's owning the RCA?
Alex Chen: I can draft the initial RCA timeline and contributing factors. Will need help from infra (Kate) and product (Emily) for impact/context.
Maria Gomez: assigning follow-ups in the doc: ACTION-1 collect deploy + routing diff (owner: Kate), ACTION-2 perf regression test to reproduce (owner: Alex), ACTION-3 customer comms summary (owner: Emily).
Kate Liu: noted ACTION-1 — will attach routing diffs and the rollback command history to the incident doc by EOD.
Sanjay Patel: scheduling the postmortem meeting — proposed: 2026-04-24 15:00 UTC. Can everyone make that? :calendar:
Alex Chen: I can.
Maria Gomez: yes.
Kate Liu: yes.
Emily Rogers: yes.
Sanjay Patel: created calendar invite and added "RCA draft due 2 hours before meeting". please add any agenda items to the doc.
Alex Chen: starting RCA draft in the incident doc — initial sections: Summary, Impact, Timeline, Contributing factors, Mitigations, Action items, Follow-ups.
Alex Chen: TIMELINE excerpt (first pass):
```
13:02 UTC — routing config deploy 2026-04-23_13:02 pushed
13:05 UTC — monitoring alert p95 > 2s
13:07 UTC — IncidentBot pages on-call
13:10 UTC — initial investigation: routing change suspected
13:15 UTC — rollback initiated
13:25 UTC — rollback completed, autoscaler scaling
13:35 UTC — p95 back toward baseline
13:50 UTC — mitigation confirmed, customers notified
```
Maria Gomez: Contributing factors (first draft): 1) routing config lacked compatibility check for model variants, 2) insufficient canary for routing changes under production load, 3) KV cache warmup not accounted for in autoscale response.
Sanjay Patel: adding systems-level notes: the routing service had a recent refactor that introduced a fallback policy change. need to link PR #4321.
Kate Liu: from infra POV: we saw memory churn on inference nodes when the incompatible model variant was selected — this triggered GC and evictions, which amplified latency. will attach heap profiles.
Emily Rogers: adding customer impact narrative and suggested comms: clear timeline, apology, remediation steps, and offer of credit if SLA breached.
Alex Chen: requesting peer review: @Sanjay @Kate @Maria please review the RCA draft and leave comments in the doc. I will iterate and produce the sign-off-ready version.
Sanjay Patel: will review and add technical remediation proposals: enforce model-variant compatibility checks in routing, add automated canary rollout for routing changes, and a pre-deploy perf smoke test.
Maria Gomez: will coordinate documentation updates and support playbooks for similar incidents.
Kate Liu: proposed technical action items (from my end):
- ACTION-A: Add compatibility validation in routing service (owner: eng-runtime team)
- ACTION-B: Add warmup hooks for KV cache on instance spinup (owner: eng-platform)
- ACTION-C: Improve observability for model selection metrics (owner: eng-infra)
All assigned in the incident doc.
Sanjay Patel: sign-off plan: after peer reviews/follow-ups, engineering manager will sign off on tech fixes, product will sign off on customer comms. Target sign-off date: 2026-04-27.
Emily Rogers: noted. I'll confirm comms draft by 2026-04-26.
Alex Chen: posting interim status in channel for visibility: we're on track for RCA draft + postmortem on 4/24, sign-off target 4/27.
IncidentBot: Reminder: postmortem meeting scheduled 2026-04-24 15:00 UTC — attendees: Alex Chen, Sanjay Patel, Kate Liu, Maria Gomez, Emily Rogers.
Maria Gomez: quick follow-up — can we include customer impact numbers in the meeting slides? I can pull them into a single slide if folks sign off on the metrics.
Sanjay Patel: yes, Alex please add the final numbers and any anonymized request traces.
Alex Chen: will add final numbers and upload RCA draft by 2026-04-24 13:00 UTC for review.
Maria Gomez: thanks — I'll draft the customer-facing note and share for review after the postmortem.
Kate Liu: one more infra ask: can we add a pre-deploy lint that rejects routing changes without variant compatibility metadata? ACTION logged.
Alex Chen: agreed. adding it to ACTION list.
Emily Rogers: thanks team — great response. :white_check_mark:
Sanjay Patel: closing the channel thread for now; updates will be in the incident doc and postmortem. If anything new pops up ping me.
Alex Chen: thanks all.
